primary_prediction_target.name: survey_recorded_annual_colonization_transition
primary_prediction_target.candidate_definition: patch is survey-recorded unoccupied at year t, has finite survey response at t+1, and has finite positive patch area at t
primary_prediction_target.source_definition: all patches survey-recorded occupied (>0) at t with finite positive patch area at t
primary_prediction_target.detection_boundary: This target is a recorded transition under the long-term survey protocol, not latent biological colonization/absence. Imperfect detection is acknowledged and no occupancy probability is inferred from a zero record.

temporal_split_rule.metadata_allowed_before_response: derive only year and patch columns from survey_data.tsv, plus full non-response patch_area.tsv
temporal_split_rule.year_sequence_requirement: at least 12 consecutive annual transitions after deterministic intersection of survey-year and patch-area-year support
temporal_split_rule.heldout_rule: last 6 consecutive annual transitions are heldout; every earlier consecutive transition is calibration
temporal_split_rule.world_state_update_during_holdout: allowed only after each heldout transition outcome has occurred; later heldout forecasts may contract the frozen rule set using earlier heldout positive transition evidence but predictive model coefficients remain calibration-frozen

world_rules.kernel_scale_type: externally supported process reference; alpha=1 km^-1 is close to independent/published estimates and is not treated as a hard maximum distance
world_rules.source_weights: equal across all currently survey-recorded occupied source patches

rules.edge_rule: all distinct patch pairs receive raw geographic support exp(-d/1km)

world_rules.sequential_rule_filter: A rule survives a transition only if every observed positive colonization target has first-passage support > 1e-15 from that transition's current occupied source set. Surviving rule IDs may stay equal or contract across transitions and are never recreated.
world_rules.universe_falsification_rule: If no frozen rule survives, preserve finite-universe falsification and stop EOG predictive comparison without retuning.

eog_one_step_support_semantics.equivalence_to_package_operator: For horizon=1, source-to-target support is computed exactly under Q[s,t]=W[s,t]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]) and equal normalized source weights, matching build_dynamic_transition_operator(loss_support=1) without materializing five dense DynamicTransitionOperator objects simultaneously.
eog_one_step_support_semantics.probability_claim: none; raw EOG supports are assumption-conditioned features unless the downstream calibration model maps them to the recorded binary target

features: target patch area at t raised to 0.2
S_i(t)=sum over occupied source patches j of area_j(t)^0.2 * exp(-distance_ij/1km)
ifm_logistic.coefficient_policy: fit L2 logistic coefficients using calibration transitions only; do not reuse coefficients fitted in publications to overlapping heldout outcomes
ifm_logistic.scientific_anchor: Hanski et al. 2017 Nature Communications DOI 10.1038/ncomms14504

features: nearest distance to an occupied source
number of occupied sources within 1 km
number of occupied sources within 2 km

identity_vs_compression_models.identity_features: ordered 5-world survival indicators followed by ordered 5-world one-step supports; eliminated worlds have survival=0 and support=0
identity_vs_compression_models.feature_dimension_note: identity and compression each contribute 10 EOG-specific dimensions beyond the identical ecological baseline

calibration_model.standardization: calibration mean/SD only; zero-SD columns dropped identically from train and heldout

identity_vs_compression_models.identity_estimability: If the exact identity design has no nonconstant information beyond the declared compression in calibration, report identity_non_estimable and do not invent extra world axes.

secondary: ROC AUC when both classes exist
metrics.independence_boundary: annual transitions are the outer temporal reporting units; thousands of patch rows are not treated as independent years and no small-n year bootstrap is used to manufacture precision

identity_favorable_if_all: identity has lower logloss than compression in at least 4 of the 6 heldout transitions
external_predictive_added_value_if_all: macro-year mean identity logloss is lower than both IFM logistic and flexible RF
identity has lower logloss than the better of the two external comparators in at least 4 of 6 heldout transitions
decision_rules.otherwise: preserve no_confirmed_added_value, adverse, non_estimable, or universe_falsified result without retuning

no_retuning_after_response: world distance kernel or structural thresholds
